quotations.old_english: Nis se foldan sceat mongum gefére folcágendra
quotations.english: the tract of earth is not easy of access to many folk-owning [men]

source_text: folc-ágende; part. Folk-owning; p&a-short;p&u-short;lum poss&i-short;dens :-- Bealg hine swíðe folcágende the folk-owning [man] was much irritated, Exon. 68a; Th. 253, 26; Jul. 186: Beo. Th. 6218; B. 3113. Nis se foldan sceat mongum gefére folcágendra the tract of earth is not easy of access to many folk-owning [men], Exon. 56a; Th. 198, 4; Ph. 5.
